title: Secret Invasion → Dark Reign → Siege
subtitle: The Skrull invasion, Osborn’s Avengers, and the siege of Asgard.
intro: A focused Avengers route from Secret Invasion to the end of Dark Reign. The core route includes the two main events, the transition one-shot, and the central Dark Avengers chapters. Recommended and optional stages expand that spine. Dark Reign is a period across many titles rather than one numbered event series. Side-track recipes repeat main-series anchors to show placement; they are alternatives to reading companions after the core, not extra rereads. This route follows comics continuity, not the television adaptation.

steps.title: The infiltration revealed
steps.why: Follow the discovery that makes the Avengers question who they can trust.
steps.match: Read #31 at the end of Revolution, then #32–37 in The Trust. These two books are consecutive for this selected stretch; #26–30 are additional earlier adventures.

steps.title: The Illuminati’s last warning
steps.why: Adds the secret council’s encounter with the approaching invasion.
steps.match: The five-issue Illuminati collection contains this chapter. The 2006 Illuminati one-shot is a different story. Earlier miniseries chapters look back over Marvel history.

steps.title: Secret Invasion: the main event
steps.why: Read the complete eight-issue invasion in order.
steps.match: Use the original eight-issue series. Mission Earth and Meet the Skrulls are different, later stories.

steps.title: Optional: the Avengers’ invasion files
steps.why: Expand the Avengers’ perspectives and flashbacks alongside the invasion, or read as companions after its main series.
steps.match: New Avengers Secret Invasion Books 1–2 cover #38–47; Mighty Avengers Books 1–2 cover #12–20. These are four complementary books. The New Avengers Modern Era Epic also overlaps its own two books, but not the Mighty Avengers chapters.

steps.title: Secret Invasion: Dark Reign
steps.why: Read immediately after Secret Invasion #8 to enter the new political order.
steps.match: Choose Power or Accept Change for the transition one-shot. Power also has New Avengers #48–50; Accept Change has other launch material. They overlap on the one-shot.

steps.title: Dark Avengers: Assemble
steps.why: Meet Osborn’s version of the Avengers.
steps.match: Choose Assemble or the Complete Collection for #1–6. Keep the Complete Collection for the later Molecule Man and Siege chapters; do not read through its ending before Siege. The verified collection contents take precedence over a conflicting imported synopsis.

steps.title: Optional: Avengers/X-Men — Utopia
steps.issues: Dark Avengers/Uncanny X-Men: Utopia; Uncanny X-Men #513–514; Dark Avengers #7–8; Exodus
steps.why: The X-Men crossover fills the gap between Dark Avengers #6 and #9.
steps.match: The Utopia collection contains the six-part crossover plus additional material. Dark Avengers: The Complete Collection omits #7–8; they are here, not missing chapters of the Molecule Man volume.

steps.title: Dark Avengers: Molecule Man
steps.why: Continue the regime’s central team story before the Asgard crisis.
steps.match: Choose the four-issue Molecule Man volume or continue in the same Complete Collection used earlier. Save #13–16 for the Siege branch below.

steps.title: Siege: The Cabal & prologue
steps.why: The immediate prelude to the attack on Asgard.
steps.match: The same Siege collection used in the next stage contains the prelude material; borrow it once. Siege Prelude is a different anthology of earlier setup, not another required volume.

steps.title: Siege: the four-part climax
steps.why: Read all four issues for the event’s central ending.
steps.match: Continue in the same book. Under Siege (1986) and Siege: Battleworld (2015) are separate stories.

steps.title: Dark Avengers: the Siege chapters
steps.why: Finish Osborn’s team story alongside the main event. This recipe expands the Siege stage rather than repeating it afterwards.
steps.match: Use Siege: Dark Avengers or the Complete Collection already used for #1–6 and #9–12. Both include the annual; it is extra context, not one of the numbered siege chapters.

steps.title: Optional: Siege — Embedded
steps.why: A civilian and media perspective on the same battle.
steps.match: This four-part companion does not replace Siege #1–4. Read as a side branch or after the main event; its final chapter belongs after Siege #4.

steps.title: New Avengers Finale
steps.why: A closing chapter for Bendis’s first New Avengers series after the battle.
steps.match: Siege: New Avengers contains the Finale alongside New Avengers #61–64 and earlier setup extras. Jump to the Finale after Siege #4 for this stage; the other contents are not all aftermath.
order: New Avengers #64 if following that branch
